title: Habit-tracker benchmark per-run metrics
description: Informal schema for runs/<run-id>/metrics.json. One file per trial (framework x phase). Consumed by scripts/score.py.

prompt_version.description: Prompt-Version header from the prompt used.

wall_clock_seconds.description: Seconds from agent start to first green (visible tests all pass). Measured during the trial, not by score.py.

agent_tool_calls.description: Total agent tool calls made to reach first green.

agent_turns.description: Number of agent conversation turns (assistant messages) in the trial.

failed_test_runs.description: How many times the acceptance suite was run and failed before first green.

human_interventions.description: Count of manual nudges/corrections a human gave the agent. 0 for a clean autonomous run.

generated_loc.description: Lines of application source the agent generated. Exclude vendored deps and lockfiles.

visible_checks_passed.description: Passing checks from acceptance/contract_test.py (the X in its RESULT line).

visible_checks_total.description: Total checks from acceptance/contract_test.py (the Y in its RESULT line).

has_tests.description: Did the agent ship automated tests for core behavior?

uses_conventions.description: Manual 0-3: how idiomatically the code uses the framework's conventions.

notes.description: Free-form reviewer notes about the run.

example.notes: Copied examples/todo-app as a base; clean run.
